summary: Decode the st3.v1 envelope in Fabric adapter membership and pairing reads

replay.detail: No startup or projection replay changes.

schema.detail: No persisted formats or database schema changes.

rules.detail: Membership verification and Fabric grant ownership are unchanged. Failed snapshot reads still cannot withdraw grants.

compatibility.detail: The adapter now reads the existing st3.v1 response envelope for leave-state and pairing admission instead of expecting an unwrapped payload. No daemon wire contract changes.

downtime.detail: Restart the adapter to use the corrected reads; no daemon restart is required.

manual.detail: No store repair or coordinated fleet upgrade is required.

recovery.detail: Rollback does not change stored state; older adapters retain the response decoding defect.
